v4.0 and v4.1 are near-duplicates: same structure, three clauses differ.
Purchase Policy v3.0 (2019) is still on the share: direct-order limit £30,000, UN 38.3 for battery packs only.
AMD-PUR-2026-03 is issued but in force only from 1 Dec 2026 (after the sandbox date of 26 Oct 2026); the policy it amends still says £50,000.
Byte-identical copy of the Supplier Policy saved twice.
Supplier Policy v2.2 (2025) and v2.3 (2026): v2.2 lacks §4.7.
Supplier Policy v2.3 §4.4 says 24 months and not expired; AMD-SUP-2026-02 replaced it from 1 Sep 2026 with 12 months and 60 days' margin. The policy PDF was not reissued.
Approval matrix v2.0 (2024) still present: executive £200,000, senior buyer £400,000, manager £750,000. v3.0 (2026) raised them.
Two T&E policies side by side: v3.0 is in force only from 1 Jan 2027; v2.4 applies today. Hotel caps and meal allowance differ.
A confidential HR folder sits inside the dump (salary bands, a draft redundancy consultation, a disciplinary register). A retriever must filter by permission before ranking.
SOP-PUR-001 v2.0 (2021) is still present: Ledgerline 6 screen names, 'vendor', and a UN 38.3 report allowed up to three months AFTER the first order, the opposite of today's rule.
File name 'Final_FINAL_onboarding checklist' does not follow the document-number naming of the other procedures.
SOP-PUR-002 v1.3 '(FINAL)' and v1.4: near-identical; v1.3 says Fetch is optional, which Ledgerline 7.2.3 no longer allows (ERR-SCR-0221).
SOP-INV-003 (2023) says counts within 2% are posted; Ledgerline 7.2.2 (June 2024) changed the cycle-count tolerance to 1.5% (INV.CNT_TOL_PCT). The SOP was never updated.
SOP-AP-002 says the AP cut-off is working day 3; an e-mail from the financial controller moved it to working day 2 from June 2026. The SOP was never reissued.

The purchasing manual (7.2.3, Jan 2025) says sessions close after 20 idle minutes and passwords are 8 characters / 90 days. Patch 7.2.3-P2 (Mar 2026) made the timeout 15 minutes, and the IT Security Policy sets 12 characters / 60 days. The manual was never updated.

The manual says Ledgerline does not check certificates on the order screen (§11.11). Patch 7.2.3-P4 added an optional check (PUR.CERT_CHK, warning W-SUP-0207), switched off at Northbridge. Both are true only if you read the CAB minutes too.
ERR-SEC-0001 is 'ACCESS DENIED' in the error reference and on screen, but 'Not authorised' in the purchasing manual's §17.26 heading.
